description: For any first-order formula \(A\) with \(k+1\) available scoped slots, no free-variable names, and possibly further quantifiers, an old-language structure satisfies \(\forall\bar x\,\exists y\,A(\bar x,y)\) if and only if some same-domain expansion by one fresh \(k\)-ary function symbol satisfies the scoped instance \(\forall\bar x\,A(\bar x,f(\bar x))\).
